concerns.text: FR-015 provides a justification for the 15 % equivalence margin but does not reference any user story (e.g., US-3). Without an explicit anchor, this functional requirement is an orphan.
FR-016 explains the choice of effect size d = 0.5 but lacks a traceability link to a user story. It is therefore an orphaned functional requirement.
FR-007 mandates CPU‑only execution but does not explicitly cite a user story (US-2 is the closest). The lack of an explicit anchor makes this requirement an orphan.
